Original SVGs are retained in tools/icons/remix.
RealmEX converts their currentColor fill to white and rasterizes at 72 x 72
for display at 24 x 24 logical pixels. Shapes are unchanged.
Regeneration: install resvg-py, then run python tools/icons/render.py.
